# Screenshot manifest for FEATURES.md - one line per image the document
# references: "image-path | config-panel-path-or-MANUAL | what it shows".
#
# AUTO rows are regenerated by scripts/make_feature_shots.ps1 (maintainer-side)
# via "kitty.exe -cfgpanel <panel> -demo-config-box <file>" - the automation
# owns FRESHNESS; which panels are shown, and every MANUAL shot, stays curated
# by hand. The same script drift-checks this list against FEATURES.md both
# ways: an image the document references must have a row here, and a row here
# must still be referenced.
#
# Panel paths are the config box's ctrl_settitle() paths; paths with spaces
# are fine (the runner quotes them). MANUAL = not a config panel (another
# window, another program, or a composed scene) - regenerated by hand.
# A row may carry a 4th field: extra kitty.ini lines for the render's clean
# room, ";"-separated, e.g. "ConfigBox:foldernavigation=yes" (section:line).
docs/features/img/config_folder.jpg        | Session                          | session list with folders + search field
docs/features/img/config_folder_nav.jpg    | Session                          | folder-rows navigation mode | ConfigBox:foldernavigation=yes
docs/features/img/config_hotkey.jpg        | Session/Startup                  | launcher global hotkey
docs/features/img/config_workplace.jpg     | Connection/Proxy/Workplace       | workplace proxy mode switch
docs/features/img/config_rutty.jpg         | Session/Scripting                | login script (RuTTY) panel
docs/features/img/config_hyperlinks.jpg    | Window/Hyperlinks                | URL hyperlink options
docs/features/img/config_password.jpg      | Connection/Data                  | auto-login password field
docs/features/img/config_autocommand.jpg   | Connection/Data                  | auto-command after login (same panel as the password - curation may prefer one image)
docs/features/img/config_forcecrlf.jpg     | Terminal/Keyboard                | Enter sends CR LF
docs/features/img/config_icon.jpg          | Window/Title                     | per-session icon chooser (the Title & Icon leaf)
docs/features/img/config_sendtotray.jpg    | Window/Behaviour                 | send-to-tray options
docs/features/img/config_transparency.jpg  | Window/Appearance/Background     | transparency options (the Background leaf)
docs/features/img/config_winscp_integration.jpg | Connection/SSH/WinSCP          | WinSCP integration panel (KSCP has its own panel now)
docs/features/img/config_zmodem.jpg        | Connection/ZModem                | ZModem transfer options
docs/features/img/config_proxychoice.jpg   | Connection/Proxy                 | named-proxy choice droplist
docs/features/img/config_proxyeditor.png   | MANUAL                           | the named-proxy editor is its own window, not a panel
docs/features/img/menu_shortcuts.jpg       | MANUAL                           | terminal window menu
docs/features/img/ex_launcher.jpg          | MANUAL                           | the tray launcher menu
docs/features/img/config_kittygen.jpg      | MANUAL                           | kittygen, not the config box
docs/features/img/ex_kageant.jpg           | MANUAL                           | kageant key list
docs/features/img/StdoutToClipboard.png    | MANUAL                           | terminal menu scene
docs/features/img/ex_protected.jpg         | MANUAL                           | protected-terminal scene
docs/features/img/ex_fonts.jpg             | MANUAL                           | terminal font scene
docs/features/img/ex_background.jpg        | MANUAL                           | terminal background-image scene
